This folder is a flat backup snapshot of the local `external/catt` tree.

Why it exists:
- `external/catt` is itself a nested Git repository cloned from
  `https://github.com/abjadai/catt.git`.
- The top-level GitHub backup repo should store restorable files, not only a
  gitlink/submodule pointer.

Snapshot intent:
- Preserve the locally used v3-side runtime/training/eval source files.
- Preserve the exported balanced_v3 runtime checkpoint:
  `catt_eo_ft_balanced_v3/catt_eo_ft_best.pt`
- Avoid copying the entire nested repository history and all large training
  checkpoints into the top-level backup repo.

Source nested repo:
- Path: `external/catt`
- Upstream remote: `https://github.com/abjadai/catt.git`
- Local nested HEAD at backup time:
  `8d5330499feb85f6625e6af632141ed2ed6065fd`

Note:
- The shared base EO pretrained weight also exists in
  `external/catt_punct_v4/models/best_eo_mlm_ns_epoch_193.pt`, so it is not
  duplicated here.
